jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for AI Products & Solutions, you'll set the vision and roadmap for AI-powered products and run delivery for them. These include generative AI copilots, agentic digital workers and intelligent automation used across healthcare operations such as claims, prior authorization, member, provider operations and care administration. You'll work with engineering, data science, architecture and business leaders to turn complex problems into AI solutions that are safe, scalable and measurable.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product vision and strategy: Set and own the vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for AI/GenAI products, tied to business goals and enterprise AI priorities
* Problem discovery: Work with business stakeholders to find high-value AI use cases, assess whether they're feasible, and build business cases with clear ROI, savings and capacity metrics
* Backlog ownership: Turn strategy into epics, features and user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Prioritize the backlog by value, risk and dependencies
* AI solution design: Work with data scientists, ML/LLM engineers and architects on model selection, prompt and agent design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Delivery leadership: Lead agile delivery across scrum teams from idea through POC, pilot, UAT and production, including release planning and go-live readiness
* AI and compliance: Make sure solutions meet
* AI principles, privacy rules (HIPAA, PHI/PII), security and model governance, including bias, explainability and auditability
* Measurement: Define and track product KPIs such as adoption, accuracy, automation rate, cycle-time reduction, cost savings and FTE capacity. Use the data to improve the product
* Stakeholder management: Present status, risks and outcomes to executive leadership. Build alignment across technology, operations and business teams
* Adoption and change management: Drive enablement through demos, office hours, documentation, FAQs and feedback loops
* Market awareness: Keep up with trends in GenAI, agentic AI, LLMOps and AI platforms, and bring in new ideas and reusable patterns
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 10+ years in technology, including 5+ years in product management or technical product ownership
* Experience managing AI/ML, GenAI or intelligent automation products from concept to production
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally or Aha!
* Proven experience building business cases and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
* Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, model evaluation and MLOps/LLMOps concepts
* Proven ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and to work credibly with engineers and data scientists
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Master's degree or MBA
* Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP or AI/ML certifications
* Experience in US healthcare (payer, provider or PBM), such as claims, utilization management, prior authorization or provider data
* Experience leading distributed, global teams

**Key Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking
* Customer focus
* Data-driven decisions
* Technical depth in AI
* Executive communication
* Collaboration
* Comfort with ambiguity
* Responsible innovation

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

  

**Team's Impact**

The Institutional Buy Side is responsible for developing and marketing industry-leading tools for portfolio management, quantitative research, risk, performance & attribution, and execution management across the investment lifecycle. Our clients include the world’s largest asset managers, asset owners, and insurance companies.

  

The Services organization is focused on evolving FactSet’s global service delivery model by streamlining operational workflows and enhancing data quality, transparency, and efficiency. This includes key service tools such as Portfolio Reconciliation Utility, Portfolio Health, Lifecycle Dashboards, and Portfolio Services Dashboards—tools that underpin FactSet’s growing Managed Services and Portfolio Services business.

  

The Services Product Management team is driving the evolution of our workflow and process monitoring tools. These products ensure transparency into the processing of data into FactSet, validating and ensuring data accuracy and completeness, and outputting the results in presentation ready format.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Product Specialist** with strong interpersonal skills, a thirst for knowledge and the capacity to implement strategic improvements that will continue to grow the Buy-Side Services product suite at an accelerated rate.

This role will have the responsibility of driving product development and influence product strategy as the team builds out the product offering to support performance, reporting and risk workflows.

* Deliver high-quality, innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our clients.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and operations to foster a culture of continuous improvement and proactively enhance our offerings.

* Work directly with clients and internal teams to identify areas for improvement and execute a vision for product success in both the short and long term.
* Contribute to the creation of requirements and specifications for tools and workflow improvements, enabling our support teams to meet the demands of accelerated client growth.
* Manage internal documentation utilized by various departments for product knowledge.
* Collaborate with engineers to fix bugs, test enhancements, and manage releases and client migrations.
* Assist with queries and bugs to ensure timely and accurate responses.
Work within an Agile environment focused on frequent continuous releases and increased transparency with stakeholders.

--------------------------

* 4+ years of industry experience.
* Strong technical, analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Creative thinker with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to take ownership of projects and bring them to completion.
Background in Product Development, Application Design, or a similar role is a plus.

------------------------

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development. · Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.  

  

**Company Culture and Benefits:** At our organization, we foster a collaborative and inclusive culture that encourages growth and innovation. We offer competitive benefits and provide ample opportunities for professional development, paving the way for exciting career advancement within the Financial-Technology industry.

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**About the Team**

The API Authentication team within Platform Security Engineering builds the security foundation that ensures every application, integration, mobile device, and AI agent connecting to ServiceNow can securely establish its identity. The team owns critical authentication capabilities including OAuth, OpenID Connect, API access policies, and mobile sign-in. As ServiceNow expands its AI capabilities, a key focus is enabling secure and trusted access for AI agents, making authentication seamless for users while keeping the platform protected.

**What you get to do in this role**:

* Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable software components with a strong emphasis on performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with product managers to translate requirements into well-architected solutions, owning features from design through delivery
* Build intuitive and extensible user experiences using modern UI frameworks, ensuring flexibility for customer-specific needs.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while enhancing existing product capabilities.
* Integrate automated testing into development workflows to ensure consistent quality across releases.
* Participate in design and code reviews ensuring best practices in performance, maintainability, and testability.
* Develop comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration and performance aspects
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by sharing best practices in engineering and quality.
* Promote a culture of engineering craftsmanship, knowledge-sharing, and thoughtful quality practices across the team.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have****:**

* Experience in leveraging critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* 5 to 8 years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products.
* Proficiency in Java, or similar object-oriented languages.
* Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization
* Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding software quality principles including reliability, observability, and production readiness.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack.
* Experience with AI-powered tools or workflows, including validation of datasets, model predictions, and inference consistency.
* Comfort with development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, profilers, source control, and Unix-based systems

**Why Join Us**

* Build and deliver high-impact software that powers digital experiences for millions of users.
* Collaborate in a culture that values craftsmanship, quality, and innovation.
* Work symbiotically with AI and automation tools that enhance engineering excellence and drive product reliability.
* Be part of a culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and shared success.

  
**Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

ECI Solutions builds cloud-based business management and ERP software for small and mid-sized companies in manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, and field service. Our Business Systems organisation runs the Salesforce platform that our global sales, revenue and customer support teams depend on every day — a single connected org that sits at the centre of our quote-to-cash and customer-support operations and integrates with our ERP, billing, CPQ, data and telephony systems.

**THE ROLE**

ECI’s customer support organisation runs on Service Cloud. Thousands of cases a month flow through it, across multiple products, regions, support tiers and channels, and it is the system our customers judge us by when something goes wrong.

We are looking for a senior developer to own the engineering behind that platform — case lifecycle, routing, entitlements, knowledge, channels, telephony and the integrations that connect support to the rest of the business — and to build the next generation of it with Agentforce and Einstein.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role on a small team. You will work directly with support operations leaders, not through three layers of translation.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Service Cloud Engineering**

* Design, build and maintain the case lifecycle: record types, case assignment, escalation, queues, milestones, entitlements and SLA enforcement.

* Build and tune Omni-Channel routing — skills-based routing, capacity models, presence, and queue design — against real support workload patterns.

* Develop Lightning Web Components and Apex to streamline the agent console: custom quick actions, guided flows, related-record panels, and macros that remove clicks from high-volume work.

* Configure and extend intake channels: Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case, Experience Cloud customer portal, chat/messaging, and in-product case creation.

* Build and maintain Knowledge: article types, approval and publishing workflows, data categories, article recommendations, and attach-to-case behaviour.

* Implement CSAT/NPS survey capture and feed the results back into reporting and coaching workflows.

**AI and Automation**

* Build Agentforce service agents for case deflection, summarisation, and assisted resolution, including topic and action design, grounding in Knowledge and Data Cloud, and testing against real case history.

* Implement Einstein capabilities such as case classification, article recommendations, reply recommendations, and work summaries.

* Design the guardrails: escalation to a human, confidence thresholds, audit logging, and measurement of whether the automation actually helped.

* Automate repetitive support operations work with Flow, Apex, and scheduled jobs.

**Integrations**

* Integrate Service Cloud with telephony/CTI (Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9 or similar), engineering issue trackers (Jira or Azure DevOps), ERP and entitlement sources, and the data warehouse.

* Build and maintain API-based integrations using REST/SOAP, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and middleware such as MuleSoft.

* Own error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation so that failed integrations are visible and recoverable rather than silent.

**Quality and Operations**

* Write unit tests with meaningful assertions and maintain coverage well above the platform minimum.

* Participate in code review both as author and reviewer, and mentor junior developers on the team.

* Support production incidents affecting the support organisation, perform root-cause analysis, and prevent recurrence.

* Deploy through a Git-based CI/CD pipeline and keep metadata under source control.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:** 5–9 years in software development, including at least 4 years building on Salesforce with substantial Service Cloud work.

* **Service Cloud depth:** Hands-on with case management, Omni-Channel routing, entitlements and milestones, Knowledge, the Service Console, and at least two intake channels in production.

* **Apex:** Strong Apex — trigger frameworks, asynchronous processing, bulkification, governor limits, and SOQL optimisation for large data volumes.

* **LWC:** Production Lightning Web Component development with modern JavaScript, including Apex wiring, events, and console-specific APIs.

* **Declarative craft:** Strong Flow skills and good judgement about when a Flow is the right answer and when it is not.

* **Integration:** Experience building API integrations with authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Named Credentials) and robust error handling.

* **DevOps:** Salesforce DX, Git, and deployment through a CI/CD pipeline.

* **Communication:** Comfortable gathering requirements directly from support managers and agents, and pushing back with a better option when the requested solution is the wrong one.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience Cloud customer or partner portal development.

* Experience supporting an internal support organisation in a SaaS or software company.

jobs.title: (Agentic) Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
We are building a durable execution process engine – a platform that bridges enterprise workflow automation and intelligent agent orchestration. This is a zero-to-one product launch from concept to market.
  
  
You will lead the product strategy and execution for one of three interconnected pillars in the platform (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents). Working alongside peer PMs and reporting to the Group PM, you'll own the complete customer journey: from defining what we build, to shipping it, to ensuring it lands with users.
  
  
This role is for a PM who has shipped complex, multi-layer platform products before and who thrives in the tension between technical ambition and customer reality.
  
  
**The Product Vision**
A durable execution engine that scales from developer laptops to enterprise clouds, bringing workflow automation, intelligent agents, and real-time data integration into one coherent platform.
  
  
Modern enterprises are stuck. Legacy workflow systems are rigid and don't integrate with AI. Code-first pipelines (Airflow, Temporal) give developers freedom but leave business analysts behind. We're building the bridge.
  
  
**Our Platform Will**

* Work for multiple personas – Business analysts author visually, engineers deploy as code, operators observe in real time. No translation layer needed.
* Treat AI as native – Intelligent agents aren't bolted on; they're first-class actors in the process execution model with full auditability and compliance guardrails.
* Connect everything – Data from any source (APIs, databases, message queues, cloud services) flows naturally through your processes without custom plumbing.
* Build toward Horizon's sophistication – Our long-term ambition is to deliver agentic orchestration depth comparable to the best-in-class products in the market.

The result: enterprises can automate complex work faster, with more control, and with confidence that their processes will execute reliably at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the product roadmap for Workflows & Orchestration – what customers need, what moves the needle, what builds defensible value
* Make the hard calls: what ships in MVP, what is post-launch, what never ships
* Own the competitive positioning – position durable processes as a first-class pillar of an integrated platform, not a standalone point solution
* Shape both pro-code and no-code experiences – own SDKs, CLI, and visual editor consistency; documentation and learning paths across both personas

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment (eng, design, marketing, sales) on priorities and milestones
* Conduct customer discovery: who are we building for, what problems do they have, what's blocking adoption
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, customer feedback, performance metrics all inform direction
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical direction isn't clear, you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with peer PMs
  
  

* You're not alone – work collaboratively with two peer IC PMs who own the Data Connectors and AI Agents pillars
* Establish clear integration points and contract boundaries so all three pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents) work together seamlessly
* Escalate only real conflicts up to the Group PM; resolve most decisions at your level

**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
Complex infrastructure or platform products
  
  

* Enterprise workflow or automation systems
* Products that span multiple user personas (business analysts, developers, operators)
* Products that required deep technical integration
* Zero-to-one launches where you shaped initial product-market fit.

Core capabilities
  
  

* Technical fluency – You read code, understand architecture constraints, and can have a real conversation with engineers about feasibility and tradeoffs. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.
* Customer obsession with realism – You spend time with users, but you're not a feature-request transcriber. You synthesize what they need from what they say.
* Decisiveness under ambiguity – You make calls with incomplete information. You're comfortable killing ideas you love if data suggests they won't work.
* Communication across layers – You talk to engineers about latency budgets, to customers about compliance, to executives about roadmap priorities. Different audiences, same honesty.
* Systems thinking – You see how pieces connect. Developer SDKs influence adoption patterns. Pricing models influence feature prioritization. You optimize for the system, not the local maximum.
* AI native – You’re using LLMs as part of your product workflow and can adapt to any tool easily. We currently use Claude Code and Cursor.

Nice to have
  
  

* 5+ years of relevant experience as a Product Manager, with a strong focus on platform products.
* Exposure to workflow engines, BPM systems, or process orchestration platforms (Camunda, Zeebe, Airflow, Temporal).
* Experience with enterprise compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA) and how they shape product architecture.
* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS scaling challenges and tradeoffs
* Previous zero-to-one product launch where you defined the initial MVP and shaped early-stage product-market fit.
* Experience building features using LLMs (it can be a hobby project).

* Work closely with the Finance and Accounting teams to streamline ledger reconciliation, refund processing, and payout tracking.

* Data Analytics & Monitoring
* Define, track, and monitor core payments KPIs such as reject, return rates
* Investigate transaction anomalies, settlement discrepancies, recon breaks and gateway downtime in collaboration with site reliability and support teams.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

We are hiring a Senior SDET for Quality Assurance team. You will design and grow Playwright automation and the tooling around it, and you will use AI across the quality lifecycle: requirements analysis, test authoring, coverage review, debugging, and reporting. You will also own functional quality for your assigned applications. That includes manual and exploratory testing when human judgment is the better instrument. Automation and AI take the repeatable work so your manual effort goes where it adds the most value. You will work on applications that support ICE financial-markets infrastructure. A miss here is not cosmetic: defects can affect trading, clearing, data integrity, or regulatory evidence. We need someone who tests with that risk in mind. This is a hands-on Senior individual contributor role. You will influence design through code, reviews, and pairing. You will not manage people, and you will not be the sole owner of the organization-wide framework.

**Responsibilities**

* Test automation
  + Design, build, and maintain Playwright automation across UI, API, and integration layers.
  + Evolve the shared framework: page and component abstractions, fixtures, test data, environment configuration, CI/CD integration, and reporting.
  + Apply automation standards and design patterns that keep suites fast, reliable, and readable.
  + Reduce flakiness and improve execution speed through metrics and root-cause analysis.
  + Run automated suites in CI/CD and partner with DevOps on environments and pipeline reliability.
* AI-enabled quality workflow
  + Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to accelerate automation authoring, refactoring, debugging, and maintenance.
  + Use AI tooling to review requirements for ambiguities, missing edge cases, and untestable criteria before development begins.
  + Generate test cases from requirements, then refine, consolidate, and prioritize them with engineering judgment. You own the final suite, not the model.
  + Find coverage gaps, duplicate effort, and weak assertions in existing suites.
  + Adopt and extend AI tooling where it pays off. Building custom agent skills or MCP servers is a plus, not the core of the job.
* Functional test ownership
  + Own functional coverage and test strategy for assigned applications across UI, services, and integration points.
  + Decide what to automate and what to keep manual based on risk, stability, execution frequency, and maintenance cost. Expect a mix of automation and exploratory work, weighted toward automation once a flow is stable.
  + Perform manual, exploratory, and scenario-based testing where human judgment matters most.
  + Triage, reproduce, and document defects, and drive them to resolution.
  + Provide evidence-based release readiness to engineering and product leadership.
  + Produce clear reporting on coverage, execution results, defect trends, and release risk.
* Technical influence
  + Raise the quality of automation through code review and pairing with QA engineers.
  + Share practical patterns for automation, AI-assisted testing, and when manual testing is still the better approach.
  + Partner with software engineers, product managers, and DevOps to move quality work earlier in the delivery cycle.
* What you will work with
  + Playwright, TypeScript or JavaScript, Node, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
  + AI coding agents used as part of normal engineering work.
  + Jira and Xray (or equivalent) for defects, plans, and execution evidence.
  + API testing against REST and, where present, GraphQL.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* 7+ years in software quality engineering or SDET roles, including 5+ years of hands-on test automation.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or a comparable modern E2E framework (Cypress, WebdriverIO, or similar), including suite structure, test data, and CI execution—not only recording or copying tests.
* Strong TypeScript or JavaScript and sound software engineering fundamentals: modular design, version control, code review, and refactoring.
* Applied experience using AI-assisted engineering tools in a routine workflow (coding agents, AI-assisted test authoring, or AI-supported requirements and code analysis).
* API test automation experience across REST or GraphQL.
* Experience contributing to a test automation framework and integrating automated tests into CI/CD.
* Strong functional testing foundation: test design techniques, risk-based prioritization, boundary and negative testing, and structured exploratory testing.
* Working knowledge of Jira, Xray, or equivalent defect and test management tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication. Test plans, defect reports, and quality summaries should be usable asynchronously.
* Ability to work on-site in Atlanta five days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep Playwright experience: framework architecture, flakiness mitigation, test data strategy, and execution at scale in CI.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and AI tools.
* Experience creating AI agent skills, custom agents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
* Contract testing experience.
* Experience helping a QA team adopt automation and AI practices in a practical, sustainable way.
* Background in a regulated or high-reliability domain, ideally financial markets, trading, clearing, or market data.

jobs.description:

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience designing architectures for Artificial Intelligence applications.
* Experience building and customizing structured execution models like (Reason + Act), Tree of Thoughts, and Plan-and-Solve loops to equip AI systems with cognitive scaffolding for decomposing unstructured goals into deterministic DAGs.

**About the job**
-----------------

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started - and as a manager, you guide the way.  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

People Operations (POps) Solutions designs and delivers SPII-compliant, enterprise-grade AI workspaces that seamlessly integrate into core People Operations workflows. Functioning as unified command centers and specialized AI co-pilots, our solutions empower POps teams to automate high-volume processes, scale operational capacity, and accelerate strategic execution across Google.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Set and communicate team priorities. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. Leverage telemetry, offline/online benchmarks, and developer tooling to improve product excellence, production reliability, and engineering execution velocity across agentic workflows.
* Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching.
* Develop the mid-term technical direction and roadmap within the scope of your (often multiple) team(s). Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
* Deliver AI-native, agentic enterprise solutions across POps Solutions core pillars building enterprise-grade agentic applications, full-stack workbenches and autonomous operational workflows.
* Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, process owners, platform teams, architects, and delivery partners, the Business Analyst/Technical Analyst/Technical Analyst drives requirement quality, process clarity, adoption readiness, and successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.

Your key responsibilities 1. Business Analysis & Requirements Management

* Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product owners, and platform teams to capture and clarify **business requirements** for ServiceNow initiatives.
* Translate business needs into **user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and backlog items**.
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, prioritized, and aligned with platform standards and out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities wherever possible.

2. Process Design & ServiceNow Solution Alignment

* Work with architects and functional leads to ensure requirements are translated into practical, scalable, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions.
* Support solution design across modules such as ITSM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, CMDB, ITOM, GRC, Legal Service Delivery, and custom applications as applicable.
* Promote process simplification, standardization, automation, and reuse of platform capabilities.

3. Backlog, Delivery & Testing Support

* Maintain and refine the product backlog in collaboration with product owners, scrum teams, and delivery partners.

* Define and support **test scenarios, UAT planning, defect triage, and business validation** to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.

Business Analysis | AI Use Case Development | Microsoft Power Platform | Life Sciences | QA & Functional Testing | AI Response Validation | Requirements Management | User Stories & Acceptance Criteria | UAT | Test Documentation | Stakeholder Management

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience in Master Data Management (MDM), Data Governance, and Business Process Analysis to support strategic Customer MDM, Product MDM, and Brand MDM.
  
  
The candidate will partner with business stakeholders, data stewards, architects, and implementation teams to define business requirements, design master data solutions, drive data governance adoption, and enable high-quality business outcomes across commercial domain for Novartis.
  
  
The role supports establishment of a single source of truth, standardized data models, governance frameworks, and improved analytics capabilities.

jobs.description:
**Senior Functional Business Analyst – IBOR / Record Keeping System (Portia)**
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Functional Business Analyst to join our Investment Book of Record (IBOR) / Record Keeping System team within the investment banking domain. This role will be responsible for driving functional analysis, solution design support, stakeholder engagement, production issue analysis, and documentation for a business-critical investment accounting platform. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted subject matter expert and will work closely with business users, product owners, technology teams, quality assurance teams, operations, and client support groups to deliver robust, compliant, and scalable functional solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders, product owners, senior functional designers, development teams, QA teams, operations, and client support groups to understand business objectives and translate them into clear functional requirements, solution specifications, user stories, and design documentation.
* Provide functional design and analysis support for system enhancements, regulatory requirements, client-driven deliverables, production issues, and strategic initiatives related to the Record Keeping System platform.
* Conduct detailed impact assessments across business functionality, database structures, accounting calculations, batch and real-time processing flows, interfaces, and upstream/downstream application dependencies.
* Analyze complex production issues, client-reported defects, data discrepancies, processing exceptions, job cycle failures, and valuation-related concerns; support timely triage, replication in DEV environment, root cause analysis, and resolution planning.
* Act as a subject matter expert for escalated support items, major incidents, major incident calls, and business-critical production events.
* Collaborate with technology teams to ensure proposed solutions are aligned with business requirements, existing technical frameworks, operational processes, risk considerations, and architectural guidelines.
* Support end-to-end middle office investment processing workflows, including trade capture, transaction processing, position and cash management, valuation generation, reconciliations, investment accounting, and reporting.
* Use SQL and data analysis techniques to validate transaction, position, cash, valuation, and reference data; support issue investigation and confirm business outcomes.
* Facilitate effective communication across business, technology, QA, operations, and support teams to ensure shared understanding of requirements, priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines.
* Support test planning, functional validation, user acceptance testing, defect review, release readiness, implementation support, and post-release stabilization activities.
* Create and maintain high-quality functional documentation, process flows, data mapping documents, design specifications, knowledge articles, and training materials.
* Provide functional and domain knowledge sharing to team members to strengthen application understanding, reduce key-person dependency, and improve overall support capability.
* Identify opportunities to improve functional documentation, issue resolution processes, operational resilience, and stakeholder engagement practices.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Extensive experience as a Functional Business Analyst, Functional Designer or Subject Matter Expert supporting IBOR, investment accounting, record keeping, portfolio accounting, or comparable financial technology platforms.
* Strong understanding of investment banking, investment accounting, financial instruments, trade lifecycle events, position management, cash processing, valuations, reconciliations, and related business calculations.
* Hands-on knowledge of IBOR / Record Keeping System functionality, business rules, data flows, database interactions, batch processing, real-time processing, and system integration patterns.
* Willingness to provide support across local and global business hours as required for critical discussions, production incidents, and project milestones.
* Experience in portfolio management, investment accounting, financial operations, middle-office operations, or investment technology is preferred.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models and financial software development environments is preferred.
* Prior exposure to RKS, PAM, Alpha, RTC, ESP, SSCD, or comparable investment accounting and data integration platforms will be considered an advantage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor/master’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Advanced degrees and/or professional certification in business analysis, finance, accounting, or technology is desirable.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------

The Checkout Experience team owns one of the most important moments in the buyer journey: helping customers complete their purchase with confidence, speed, and clarity. The space includes guest and member checkout, express payment experiences, checkout success, and key dependencies across cart, payments, shipping, and post-purchase experiences.

  
  

We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead complex, high-impact checkout initiatives that reduce friction, improve buyer trust, and unlock conversion at scale. In this role, you will define and drive multiple initiatives across the checkout funnel, influence cross-functional roadmaps, and help shape the future of Checkout Experience.

----------------------------

* Lead multiple Checkout Experience initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Identify the biggest sources of buyer friction and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Partner across Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, and adjacent product teams to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Drive improvements across areas such as guest checkout, member checkout, express payments, delivery clarity, payment optimization, incentives, and checkout success.
* Use analytics, experimentation, and customer insights to make decisions and refine the roadmap.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders and align teams around tradeoffs, sequencing, and success metrics.
* Contribute to the longer-term vision for checkout, including personalization, modernized flows, and AI-assisted experiences.
  

  

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Experience owning multiple customer-facing products or features end to end in a consumer, ecommerce, marketplace, or payments environment.
* 8+ years of relevant experience
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and priorities.
* Comfort using data, experimentation, and customer insights to size opportunities and guide decisions.
* Ability to write clear product requirements with strong hypotheses, success metrics, and execution plans.
* Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Domain depth, or quickly demonstrated depth, in checkout, payments, buyer experience, ecommerce, or conversion optimization.
* A bias toward action, strong prioritization instincts, and the ability to operate with autonomy in a fast-moving environment.

jobs.description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are looking for an ambitious, systems-thinking, and highly analytical Product Manager to take ownership of our foundational cash management, treasury, and settlement ecosystem. As our transaction volume scales, the complexity of moving money efficiently, securely, and reliably becomes paramount.
  
  
In this role, you will be the driving force behind the core systems that govern optimal liquidity, power seamless financial operations, and establish direct integrations with central payment networks. You will navigate complex regulatory and technical landscapes, starting with optimizing our daily liquidity and settlement operations. Over time, you will spearhead the evolution of this function from an operational backbone into a highly strategic, value-generating engine that optimizes our working capital and financial intelligence.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Drive Core Treasury Platforms: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for our treasury and liquidity management platforms, translating complex financial workflows into scalable, automated product architectures.
* Optimize Money Movement: Design and launch scalable products that automate fund flows, optimize merchant payouts, and ensure seamless money movement across our internal and external ecosystems.
* Build for System Resilience: Develop highly fault-tolerant platform capabilities that guarantee business continuity, intelligent transaction routing, and systemic resilience against external network or banking outages.
* Enable Financial Intelligence: Create product features and tools that empower our finance and treasury teams with advanced cash flow forecasting, real-time visibility, and strategic capital optimization.
* Manage Complex Integrations: Lead the product strategy for secure and robust API integrations with key financial networks and banking partners to expand our foundational operational capabilities.
* Embed Compliance & Controls: Ensure all treasury products are built with a compliance-first mindset, incorporating automated reconciliation, rigorous financial controls, and seamless auditability.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2 to 4 years of proven experience in Product Management, successfully taking complex, backend-heavy products from conception to launch.
* Domain Preference: Prior experience in Fintech, Banking, Payments, or building highly scalable backend platform products is highly preferred (though not a strict requirement for a fast learner with strong fundamentals).
* Technical Acumen: Ability to deeply understand and orchestrate complex transaction flows, messaging architectures, and secure API integrations between internal ledgers and external financial institutions.
* Analytical Rigor: Exceptional data-driven problem-solving skills. You should be comfortable navigating complex financial workflows, large-scale reconciliations, and designing solutions for intricate edge cases.
* Strategic Execution: A strong bias for action with the ability to balance immediate operational requirements with long-term, highly scalable platform architecture.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You will need to collaborate seamlessly with and influence engineering, finance, treasury operations, and legal/compliance teams.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Tokenisation & Stablecoin Infrastructure
jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Tokenization & Stablecoin Infrastructure team and drive the products that let institutions issue, mint, redeem, custody, and move stablecoins and tokenized real-world assets. You will work closely with stablecoin issuers, asset managers, banks, and token foundations, along with engineering, compliance, legal, and go-to-market teams, to bring new issuers and assets onto BitGo's regulated infrastructure.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where regulation, market structure, and technology are evolving together. You will own the roadmap, shape strategy, and see products through from first customer conversation to launch and scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap, strategy, and execution for BitGo's tokenization and stablecoin infrastructure, including mint/burn and redemption flows, issuance workflows, reserve and settlement integrations, and tokenized asset lifecycle management.
* Lead and motivate a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and operations and compliance partners to build institutional-grade solutions.
* Scope and ship new issuer and asset integrations end to end: write PRDs, define order, fee, and settlement flows, align on custody and security models, and drive launch readiness.
* Partner with stablecoin issuers, tokenized fund and asset managers, banks, and ecosystem and blockchain foundations to understand needs, shape partnerships, and turn them into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off builds.
* Work with compliance, legal, and risk teams to make sure every product meets regulatory, security, and licensing requirements across jurisdictions.
* Evaluate new chains, token standards, and market-structure developments (for example, tokenized securities, tokenized deposits, and onchain settlement) and turn them into a clear point of view and prioritized opportunities.
* Define and track success metrics such as issuer onboarding time, volumes, revenue, and reliability, and iterate based on data and client feedback.
* Work with GTM, sales, and client success teams on positioning, pricing, and client enablement, and act as a trusted product partner to key clients.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**About WisdomAI**
WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast-paced, early-stage startup, currently ~30 people and growing.
  
  
**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands-on function built for the age of AI-native product development. We are a build-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
  
  
At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.
  
  

* Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
* Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context.
* Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team.
* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM-first, Design-first, or Dev-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.

**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?
* You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.

**About the company**

Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory & transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.

**Role Overview** **:**

The QA Analyst is responsible for developing and supporting the planning, design, and execution of test cases for custom development efforts in the eDiscovery realm to ensure that the product meets minimum quality standards, is fully functional and user-friendly prior to production release. To be successful as a quality analyst, you should demonstrate strong attention to detail and have analytical and problem-solving abilities. **Employment Type**
-------------------

**Closing Date**
----------------

11 Nov 2026 11:59pm

**Job Title**
-------------

Observability Senior Software Engineer

**Job Summary**

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Shape the future of observability at scale.

  

We're looking for a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer (Observability) with 10+ years of IT experience to help elevate observability maturity across a large and complex technology landscape. In this role, you'll design and implement modern observability solutions, establish engineering standards, and enable development teams to build resilient, observable systems from day one.

  

This is a unique opportunity to work on 2,000+ applications, contribute to cutting-edge AI-driven initiatives, and influence observability practices at enterprise scale.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Design and implement scalable observability architectures, frameworks, and standards.
* Build and enable solutions such as **Observability as Code** , **OpenTelemetry (OTEL)** , common logging frameworks, and AIOps capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to embed observability throughout the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop dashboards, alerts, and proof-of-concept solutions using industry-leading observability tools.
* Drive application observability maturity and create reusable templates, patterns, and code-based solutions for broader adoption.
Collaborate with Product Owners, SREs, Agile teams, and business stakeholders to solve complex operational challenges.  

  

**What You'll Bring**

  

**Must-Have Skills**

* Deep expertise in **Observability** architecture, frameworks, and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with **Splunk** , **New Relic** , and observability tooling.
* Strong software engineering and coding capabilities.
* Experience instrumenting logs, traces, and metrics at scale.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and DevOps principles.
* Experience implementing observability solutions across multiple technology domains.
Knowledge of Agile delivery practices.  

**Nice to Have**

* Java development experience.
* ITIL, incident, change, and problem management knowledge.
* AWS or other cloud certifications.
* Solution design or architecture experience.
* Security and secure coding knowledge.
Telecommunications industry experience.  

  

**Why Join Us?**

* Influence observability strategy across a large enterprise environment.
* Work on innovative AI-focused initiatives and next-generation engineering solutions.
* Drive measurable improvements in application reliability and operational excellence.
Collaborate with experienced engineers and technology leaders while solving complex, high-impact challenges.  

  

If you're passionate about observability, engineering excellence, and building solutions that operate at enterprise scale, we'd love to hear from you.

  

**Diversity is more than a policy – it’s how we thrive**

We know diverse teams deliver better outcomes, and we’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels safe, respected, and supported — regardless of gender, background, or ability.

We strongly encourage women and gender-diverse people to apply and are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements or adjustments to the recruitment process

jobs.description:
**Job Description – QA Engineer**

**Experience: 2–4 Years | Manual + Automation Testing**

**Position Overview**

2–4 years of experience in software testing, with strong hands-on experience in Manual Testing and Automation Testing using Playwright with TS/JS.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of web applications by designing and executing test scenarios, identifying defects, and developing automated test scripts.

**Must have**-

2–4 years of hands-on experience in Functional, Regression, Integration, and Sanity testing for Web or Mobile applications.

Ability to write and execute SQL queries (SELECT, JOINS, filters) for backend data validation

Basic understanding of automation concepts or exposure to tools like Playwright(TS/JS)

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manual Testing**

* Understand business requirements, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.
* Create and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data and test checklists.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Execute test cases across different browsers and environments.
* Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.
* Perform defect retesting and regression testing after fixes.
* Participate in requirement discussions and identify potential gaps or ambiguities early.
* Validate end-to-end business workflows and integrations.
* Support release validation and production verification activities.

**Automation Testing**

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright and TS/JS
* Build reusable and maintainable automation frameworks following Page Object Model (POM) principles.
* Automate critical business workflows and regression scenarios.
* Create and maintain test suites for cross-browser testing.
* Implement appropriate assertions, waits, test data handling, and reusable utilities.
* Analyze automation failures and distinguish between application defects and automation/script issues.
* Maintain automation scripts as application functionality evolves.
* Integrate automated test execution with CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
* Generate and review automation test reports.

**Collaboration & Process**

* Work closely with Developers, Business Analysts/Product Owners, and other QA team members.
* Review requirements and provide QA estimates and testing impact analysis.
* Contribute to improving QA processes, standards, and automation coverage.
* Support release readiness and communicate testing status, risks, and outstanding defects.

**Required Skills**

**Testing**

* 2–4 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Testing.
* Strong understanding of STLC and SDLC.
* Good knowledge of functional and non-functional testing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with test case design and defect management.
* Experience with regression, smoke, sanity, integration, and end-to-end testing.

**Automation**

* Hands-on experience with Playwright.
* Good knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript.
* Experience developing automated test scripts and reusable test components.
* Understanding of Page Object Model (POM).
* Experience with API testing is an advantage.
* Knowledge of CI/CD and tools such as GitHub Actions is preferred.

**Tools & Technologies**

* Playwright
* TypeScript / JavaScript
* Git / GitHub
* Test management / defect tracking tools
* CI/CD tools
* Basic knowledge of SQL is preferred

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with BDD / Gherkin / Cucumber is an advantage.
* Experience with healthcare, billing, laboratory, or other workflow-driven applications is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Business Systems Analyst**
**Do you thrive on solving complex business challenges, translating requirements into impactful solutions, and driving continuous improvement?**
**Join our team as a Senior Business Systems Analyst!**
**Partner with the best**
As a Senior Business Systems Analyst, you will partner with global business stakeholders, technology teams, and cross-functional leaders to translate business needs into scalable system solutions. We are looking for a strategic and proactive problem solver who can navigate complex requirements, optimize business processes, and drive solutions throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will take ownership of business analysis activities, facilitate stakeholder collaboration, mentor fellow analysts, and help deliver technology enhancements that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
  
  
As a Senior Business Systems Analyst, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading stakeholder workshops, understanding business needs, identifying pain points, and translating them into clear functional requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria.
* Mapping current and future-state processes, identifying gaps and inefficiencies, and recommending opportunities for workflow optimization and automation.
* Collaborating with architects, developers, and QA teams to evaluate system capabilities, assess integration opportunities, and ensure solutions align with business objectives.
* Managing requirements traceability, supporting development and testing activities, overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and driving defect resolution to ensure successful delivery.
* Evaluating system enhancements, conducting impact assessments and root cause analysis, and supporting implementations, migrations, releases, and user adoption through effective documentation and training.
* Maintaining process maps, functional specifications, system workflows, and project documentation while leveraging data analysis tools to support informed decision-making.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Will**

* Bring 5+ years of experience in business systems analysis, systems design, product/IT consulting, or a related field.
* Having a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or possess equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall methodologies, with experience managing business analysis activities across the SDLC.
* Have hands-on experience with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar data analysis tools to support business insights and decision-making.
* Understand APIs, data models, and enterprise system integrations, with the ability to assess system dependencies and evaluate technical solutions.
* Be proficient in tools such as Jira, Confluence, Lucidchart, Visio, Miro, or Draw.io for requirements management, collaboration, and process documentation.
* Demonstrate excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
